integrity.computational_evidence: Standalone verification includes exhaustive joint determinant/eigenspace counts over orders 2, 3, 4 and all 86016 binary six-dimensional automorphisms.
integrity.proof_basis: Subspace moments and explicit GL3 conjugacy classes; exact calculation is supportive, not infinite certification.
integrity.publication_priority: No unconditional claim of priority or independent validation.

scientific_limitations: This result counts finite-field linear Lie automorphisms of the free class-two rank-three algebra only; it is not a conjugacy-class census or a statement about arbitrary quotients. The prior-work comparison has a residual bibliographic risk, particularly the 2010 full text.
title: Complete fixed-space census for automorphisms of the free two-step Lie algebra on three generators
